summary: Gone Mount Hood NF lookout: 1928 rag camp, 1931 L-4 cab, end dated 1952 or 1953; summit now a clearing reached on foot by the Douglas Trail.

access.note: Reached on foot by a hike from the Douglas Trailhead, per Oregon Hikers; no closure or restriction is described in the sources read

visit.trail_note: Out-and-back hike; the spur to the summit is unmarked, so watch for it at the crest of the Douglas Trail

resolved_conflicts.explanation: End date conflicts: the FFLOS register says the lookout was removed in 1952; firelookout.com says destroyed in 1953. Both are kept as events and the story reports both.

sources.title: Douglas Trail to Wildcat Mountain Hike

notes_for_editor: The record says kind 'ground', but the sources say only 'rag camp' and 'L-4 cab' and never say whether the cab stood on a tower, so the record was not changed. End date conflicts (1952 vs 1953). Today's description comes from a 2013 blog and an undated field guide; no source describes remains. Access is inferred from the hiking guide, not from a land-manager notice. The guide warns that target shooters are abundant along the roads around the trailhead and asks for caution; the story does not mention this. A search also surfaced a different Wildcat Mountain site (WNF, 1934 L-4 cab) which is not this record and was not used.
